split_manifest.protocol: F1-F10 train; F11-F12 checkpoint selection; F13-F16 q calibration; T1-T3 untouched test
split_manifest.note: Scene disjointness and byte duplicates checked; near-duplicate/participant overlap not independently verified.

calibration.uncertainty_note: Wilson assumes independent trials; neighboring frames are correlated. Scene bootstrap has only four groups; not a precision guarantee.
calibration.sampling_note: Recall is conditional on annotated/visible people, not on fully invisible/unlabelled victims.

metadata.grid_geometry: pixel edges from bounds and heatmap shape; cell_size_m is nominal
metadata.mapping: q[k,j]=person-level recall for UAV k resolution, constant over cells; POP condition-mixture transfer assumption
metadata.observation: one designated detector frame in a fixed hover dwell; no independent multi-frame assumption
metadata.physical_model: 2D Euclidean flight, common base at SAREnv center, time zero launch; no collision/no-fly/communication model
